main.summary: Implements in-process keyed asynchronous coordination for segmented transfer mutations.

field.name: locks
field.summary: Maps transfer coordination keys to the semaphores that serialize access for those keys.

method.name: AcquireAsync
method.summary: Acquire the semaphore associated with a coordination key and return an async releaser for it.
method.param: Coordination key for the item or session lock.
method.returns: Disposable releaser that will unlock the acquired semaphore.

main.summary: Releases an acquired semaphore exactly once when the asynchronous lock scope is disposed.

field.name: gate
field.summary: Semaphore instance to release when disposal completes.

field.name: released
field.summary: Tracks whether the releaser has already returned the semaphore permit.

constructor.name: Releaser
constructor.summary: Create the async releaser for an acquired semaphore.
constructor.param: Semaphore instance that was previously acquired.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Release the semaphore once and complete synchronously.
method.returns: Completed task after the semaphore has been released if needed.
